svg.title: Four State Space Applications
svg.desc: Dynamic factors and nowcasting, time-varying parameter regression, stochastic volatility, Markov switching — what you make the state is the whole design decision.
svg.text: What becomes the state — that one choice determines the whole model
How to read the economy right now from dozens of indicators
Real-time, with mixed frequency and gaps left as they are
How the relationship itself changed over time
Structural change in beta or sensitivity, estimated with intervals
How high is volatility now, and how uncertain is that
Variance itself is the state — inferred by particle filters or MCMC
Which regime are we in, and when did it change
Transition probabilities come with expected durations
What separates these four is not the algorithm but what was chosen as the state.
Fix the state and the equations and constraints follow; one recursion handles inference.
f, β, h, S — only what goes into α
differs; the equations keep their shape
Labels inside the cells are the sheets in this series that cover that topic.
